description: This Java class 'ReceiverActivity' is part of an Android application. It defines an activity that receives a message from another activity (SenderActivity) via intent extras and displays it in a TextView.

classes.name: ReceiverActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a message received via an intent extra.

methods.name: makeIntent
methods.description: Creates a new Intent to launch ReceiverActivity with a specified message.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves the message from intent extras, and sets it in the TextView.
